summary: A great Blitz: almost any hit you name scores. As a classic it is brutal, because the most famous songs (Despacito, Old Town Road, Bad Guy) all cost a life.
reasons: Casual found 2 (Blinding Lights, Shape of You) and was out of lives by guess 7 on Despacito, Old Town Road, Bad Guy #83, Uptown Funk #96 and Dance Monkey #34.
Fan reached 10/10 with 1 life left; Sweater Weather, One Dance and Stay are the 'oh, that one' answers.
Blitz: 22 of 27 quick casual names scored, with a nice spread of values.
fixes: Guesses with the artist ('perfect ed sheeran', 'starboy the weeknd') are not recognized; players type songs that way. Needs a matcher change in src/game (coordinator) or 'title artist' aliases for the top 100.
Use consistent title case in names: 'Shape Of You', 'Die With A Smile', 'In The End', 'Locked Out Of Heaven' should read 'Shape of You', 'Die with a Smile', 'In the End', 'Locked Out of Heaven'.
